text:
alex: FYI scheduling the cross-service cutover for the API/runtime/console/router tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Plan: small canary (5%), 30m observation, ramp to 50% then 100% if healthy. Can everyone ack ownership?
priya: runtime ack. I'll pin model v2.3.1 on dedicated pools during the window. If KV eviction spikes > 10% we'll halt.
jamie: router ack. I'll hold the header-swap flag during the canary and keep a 10% steer back to v2.2 if latency > 200ms P95.
lin: console ack. Release notes are drafted, pushing to /release-notes/drafts. If console API errors > 1% send rollback signal.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary started for service=runtime variant=v2.3.1 pct=5% ts=1807772100
opsbot: perf-alert: runtime pod evictions increased from 0.2% -> 3% in last 5m; still below threshold.
alex: thx. Quick checklist — keep it tight:
```
- pin versions on dedicated pools
- start canary 5% for 15m
- run smoke evals (end-to-end): /smoke/run --route api/health
- observe telemetry: p95 latency, errors, evictions
- if any threshold hit -> immediate pause & announce rollback owner
```
priya: smoke evals run now, small sample looks fine. posting snippet: `curl -sS https://staging.api/health | jq .status` -> "ok"
jamie: routing split ready. Using `routerctl split set --svc api --pct 5 --tag v2.3.1`
alex: who is explicit rollback owner if things go south? we need one steward.
lin: console will own rollback for any UI regressions (error rate/cascade). For infra issues priya needs to call rollback.
priya: agreed. runtime will own infra rollback. I'll trigger unpin and cut back to v2.2.
jamie: if router sees >200ms p95 for 3 consecutive 1m windows i'll shift traffic back to v2.2 and mark for rollback.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary health: ok=412 fail=3 p95=118ms pct=5 ts=1807772400
opsbot: note: increase in GC pauses noted in runtime logs; tracking.
alex: decision rules for rollback (short):
- manual rollback if any one of: errors >1% (service), p95 >200ms for 3m (router), evictions >10% (infra)
- auto-pause on threshold breach, then steward must ack to resume or execute rollback
jamie: can we add a quick toggle to the release-notes so on-call knows the exact rollback command? propose adding snippet: `routerctl split set --svc api --pct 0 --tag v2.3.1 && routerctl split set --svc api --pct 100 --tag v2.2`
lin: added to notes and pinged #oncall with the link.
priya: if rollback, runtime action is: unpin pool, redeploy v2.2, flush KV cache when safe. command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=v2.2` (dry run first).
alex: ok good. Final: who will post release notes and close the change window?
lin: I will publish the release-notes and close the window after 1h stable at 100%.
priya: will keep watch for 30m after full ramp for any infra creep.
jamie: router will keep 24/7 keepout flag for 6h in case of delayed regressions.
deploybot: deploybot: Traffic ramp complete -> 100% v2.3.1 ts=1807773600 status=green
opsbot: perf-check at 30m post-ramp: p95=130ms errors=0.3% evictions=0.5%
alex: excellent. I'll annotate the runbook and mark owners. If anything trips, call the rollback owner and paste the commands. :thumbsup:
priya: thanks all, will update the pins doc.
lin: publishing notes now -> https://internal/release-notes/1807771213
jamie: thanks — standing by for any rollback signal."
